set -eu
install -d -o lp -g lp -m 0750 /srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed
semanage fcontext -a -t print_spool_t '/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed(/.*)?'
restorecon -RFv /srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed
cat > /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive <<'ARCHIVE_BACKEND'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'direct archive:/ "Electronic Archive" "Electronic Archive Printer"'
    exit 0
fi

if [ "$#" -lt 5 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: Invalid CUPS backend invocation.' >&2
    exit 1
fi

job_id=$1
title=$3
outdir=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed
safe_title=$(printf '%s' "$title" | tr -cs 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_' | sed 's/^_*//; s/_*$//' | cut -c1-80)
[ -n "$safe_title" ] || safe_title=untitled
final="$outdir/${job_id}-${safe_title}.prn"
temp="$outdir/.${job_id}.tmp"
umask 027

# A CUPS retry of the same job ID must not create or replace another archive.
if [ -e "$final" ]; then
    printf 'INFO: Archive for CUPS job %s already committed.\n' "$job_id" >&2
    exit 0
fi

trap 'rm -f "$temp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
if [ "$#" -ge 6 ] && [ -n "$6" ]; then
    cat -- "$6" > "$temp"
else
    cat > "$temp"
fi
chmod 0640 "$temp"
mv "$temp" "$final"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'INFO: Archived CUPS job %s as %s.\n' "$job_id" "$final" >&2
exit 0
ARCHIVE_BACKEND
chown root:root /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive
chmod 0755 /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive
